raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

EAGLE target verify gives every request exactly `num_tokens_per_req` (= `draft_token_num`) query rows: `EagleVerifyInput` builds `qo_indptr` as a constant-stride arange. FlashInfer's FA2 CUDA-graph planner cannot see that from the ragged CSR alone, so it sizes its query tile for the worst case (`total_rows - bs + 1` rows per request). For a typical verify batch (32 q-heads, TP8, 4 draft tokens) that means running a 64-row tile on a 16-packed-row problem.

[flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6144](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/6144) added a `uniform_q_len` keyword to `BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper.plan()`: a host-side promise that every request has exactly that many query rows, letting the planner size the tile for `uniform_q_len * gqa_group_size` packed rows. The same hint is the dispatch key for FlashInfer's specialized SM90 fp8-KV verify kernel from that PR.

## Modifications

One wiring change in `flashinfer_backend.py`: `call_begin_forward` adds `uniform_q_len=num_tokens_per_req` to the paged plan kwargs when

- the batch is an EAGLE verify batch (`SpecInputType.EAGLE_VERIFY`; DFLASH / NGRAM verify and draft extends keep the stock plan),
- the installed FlashInfer's `plan()` accepts the keyword (checked once per wrapper class via `inspect.signature`; a `**kwargs`-only `plan()` fails closed), and
- the plan is the real one (`fast_prefill_plan` never serves the custom-mask verify plan).

On a FlashInfer without the keyword the plan call is byte-for-byte unchanged, so this merges safely ahead of the version bump. The hint also cannot break a plan on a capable FlashInfer: the planner re-checks the promise against `qo_indptr` on the host and falls back to the stock plan if it doesn't hold.

Adds a CPU unit test for the gating (capability check fails closed, only EAGLE verify batches are hinted, unset `num_tokens_per_req` is not a promise).

## Benchmarks

Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8, TP8/EP8 on 8x H200, EAGLE (`steps 3 / topk 1 / draft 4`), 256k-context agentic workload at 10 concurrent sessions, 1 h steady state per arm. Reported metric: **normalized interactivity** (output tokens/s per request over each request's own decode, so it isolates decode speed from TTFT and queueing). Each arm is compared against a production run of the same day on the same hardware; cross-day control drift was 1.8% at p50 and 3.7% at p90.

| configuration | p50 | p90 |
|---|---|---|
| baseline (no hint, same-day control per arm) | 113.5 / 115.5 tok/s | 63.6 / 65.9 tok/s |
| `uniform_q_len` hint (planner tile only) | 130.5 tok/s (**+15.0%**) | 71.0 tok/s (**+11.6%**) |
| hint + FlashInfer's SM90 fp8-KV verify kernel (dispatches behind the same hint) | 136.1 tok/s (**+17.8%**) | 73.6 tok/s (**+11.7%**) |

Corresponding ITL p50: −15.0% and −19.4%. Output tok/s +6%, accept length unchanged (3.30 vs 3.28), output lengths unchanged, GSM8K accuracy at parity (197 vs 196 / 200 correct, paired).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code: `pre-commit run --all-files`
- [x] Add unit tests
- [x] Update documentation / benchmarks as needed

 Each backend supports two operators: extend (i.e. prefill with cached prefix) and decode.

@@ -177,6 +178,29 @@ class PrefillMetadata:

+# Decided once per wrapper class; a **kwargs-only plan() fails closed.
+@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
+def _prefill_plan_accepts_uniform_q_len(wrapper_cls) -> bool:

+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return False

+
+def _verify_plan_uniform_q_len(*, wrapper_paged, spec_info) -> Optional[int]:
+    """EAGLE verify gives every request num_tokens_per_req query rows (a constant-stride
+    qo_indptr), which FlashInfer's FA2 CUDA-graph planner uses to size its query tile;
+    FlashInfer re-checks the promise against qo_indptr on the host, so a wrong hint
+    degrades to the stock plan rather than failing. None keeps plan() unchanged."""
+    if spec_info is None or spec_info.spec_input_type != SpecInputType.EAGLE_VERIFY:
+        return None
+    if not _prefill_plan_accepts_uniform_q_len(type(wrapper_paged)):
+        return None
+    if spec_info.num_tokens_per_req <= 0:
+        return None
+    return int(spec_info.num_tokens_per_req)
+

@@ -0,0 +1,83 @@
+"""The uniform_q_len hint for FlashInfer's EAGLE target-verify paged plan must be
+passed only to a FlashInfer whose plan() takes the keyword and only for EAGLE verify
+batches; every other plan call stays byte-for-byte the previous one."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.flashinfer_backend import (
+    _prefill_plan_accepts_uniform_q_len,
+    _verify_plan_uniform_q_len,
+)
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info import SpecInputType
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _PlanWithHint:
+    def plan(self, qo_indptr, kv_indptr, *args, uniform_q_len=None, **kwargs):
+        return uniform_q_len
+
+
+class _PlanWithoutHint:
+    def plan(self, qo_indptr, kv_indptr, *args, **kwargs):
+        return None
+
+
+class _PlanKwargsOnly:
+    def plan(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        return None
+
+
+def _spec_info(kind=SpecInputType.EAGLE_VERIFY, num_tokens_per_req=4):
+    return SimpleNamespace(spec_input_type=kind, num_tokens_per_req=num_tokens_per_req)
+
+
+class TestVerifyPlanUniformQLen(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_capability_check_fails_closed_without_the_keyword(self):
+        self.assertTrue(_prefill_plan_accepts_uniform_q_len(_PlanWithHint))
+        self.assertFalse(_prefill_plan_accepts_uniform_q_len(_PlanWithoutHint))
+        # a **kwargs-only plan() would swallow the keyword silently or raise later
+        self.assertFalse(_prefill_plan_accepts_uniform_q_len(_PlanKwargsOnly))
+
+    def test_only_eagle_verify_batches_on_a_capable_flashinfer_are_hinted(self):
+        hinted = _verify_plan_uniform_q_len(
+            wrapper_paged=_PlanWithHint(), spec_info=_spec_info(num_tokens_per_req=4)
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(hinted, 4)
+        for wrapper in (_PlanWithoutHint(), _PlanKwargsOnly()):
+            self.assertIsNone(
+                _verify_plan_uniform_q_len(
+                    wrapper_paged=wrapper, spec_info=_spec_info()
+                )
+            )
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            _verify_plan_uniform_q_len(wrapper_paged=_PlanWithHint(), spec_info=None)
+        )
+        for kind in (
+            SpecInputType.EAGLE_DRAFT,
+            SpecInputType.EAGLE_DRAFT_EXTEND,
+            SpecInputType.DFLASH_VERIFY,
+            SpecInputType.NGRAM_VERIFY,
+        ):
+            self.assertIsNone(
+                _verify_plan_uniform_q_len(
+                    wrapper_paged=_PlanWithHint(), spec_info=_spec_info(kind=kind)
+                )
+            )
+
+    def test_unset_num_tokens_per_req_is_not_a_promise(self):
+        # SpecInput defaults num_tokens_per_req to -1; 0 must not be read as a hint either
+        for value in (-1, 0):
+            self.assertIsNone(
+                _verify_plan_uniform_q_len(
+                    wrapper_paged=_PlanWithHint(),
+                    spec_info=_spec_info(num_tokens_per_req=value),
+                )
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
